title: GitHub Actions pinned to mutable tags
impl: SHA-pinned every live `uses:` (KNOWN_ACTION_PINS + pypa/codeql); added Dependabot and Renovate pin updaters.

title: Public `pull_request` jobs execute untrusted code on self-hosted `arc-x86`
impl: PR jobs run on ubuntu-latest with persist-credentials false; editable install is push-only; concurrency + 30m timeouts added.

title: PyPI OIDC publish: floating publisher, no environment, no split-trust
impl: Split build (no OIDC) / attest / publish; environment pypi; ubuntu-latest; tags v[0-9].*; workflow permissions {}.

title: No `timeout-minutes` on live ARC workflows
impl: Already closed by CH-0002 (ci.yml timeout 30 + concurrency) and CH-0003 (publish.yml timeout 15).

title: Draft L8 workflow would inherit default token and unpinned actions
impl: contents:read permissions, persist-credentials false; SHA pins already from CH-0001; still if:false.

title: Pre-commit pins are movable tags; no secret-scan hook
impl: Pin hook revs to SHAs; pin mypy extras with ==; add detect-secrets hook.

title: `init-backend` writes outside the intended base directory
impl: folder_name must be a single path segment; reject abs/empty/./../separators; dest is_relative_to(base); return 1 on error.

title: BackendInit `.gitignore` merge follows symlinks
impl: _ensure_gitignore and _write_if_absent skip symlink paths; target file contents are unchanged.

title: Generated `GITIGNORE_FULL` ignores real source trees
impl: Dropped lib/, lib64/, and env/ from GITIGNORE_FULL. .venv/ and venv/ remain.

title: Unconfined `baseline_path` join
impl: Reject absolute/`..` baseline_file; resolved path must be_relative_to(project_path) before load/save.

title: Unsigned baseline is a suppression oracle
impl: `matches` requires message or violation_id; unsigned/rewritten `.asgard-baseline.json` HMAC-fails to empty (no suppressions).

title: Fuzzy match with empty message suppresses a whole file+type
impl: Empty/whitespace fuzzy keys unmatched; persist `violation_id` instead of blank; SecretFinding.message is pattern:masked_value.

title: Raw violation text persisted and dumped
impl: Persist sha256 of message/snippet attrs; default JSON report and CLI list omit `message`. Matching hashes both sides.

title: Baseline save is non-atomic and follows symlinks
impl: Refuse dest symlink; load without exists(); save via temp + os.replace.

title: 12-hex violation IDs collide; `remove_entry` deletes every match
impl: `generate_violation_id` stores the full SHA-256. `remove_entry` deletes only a unique match (optional file/line).

title: Unbounded CIR parse / walk / LCOM4 (local DoS)
impl: Cap CIR source bytes/lines; iterative _walk with node/depth budgets; LCOM4 skips and SRP flags classes over 128 methods; evidence string capped.

title: Architecture bounds cache is unsigned and unvalidated
impl: HMAC + schema on arch bounds cache; malformed hydrate is a miss (full infer).

title: `fnmatch` on attacker-controlled architecture.yml patterns
impl: Sanitize path_patterns (max length 200, max 8 `*`, strings only). Matchers skip oversized globs.

title: Markdown reporters interpolate scan-controlled strings unescaped
impl: Shared md_cell() escapes pipes, backticks, control chars, and HTML in Bragi Markdown table cells.

title: Architecture YAML loader: caller path + no schema
impl: Require is_file + 256 KiB cap; layers must be mappings; coerce list fields. Keep yaml.safe_load.

title: Regex SOLID fallback ReDoS on large source lines
impl: JS/TS method patterns bound to .{0,200}; all regex SOLID checks skip lines over 4096 chars.

title: Unbounded tree-sitter recursion can abort a multi-language SOLID run
impl: Iterative TS walk with depth/node/byte/line caps; RecursionError/MemoryError skip the file.

title: Local `CLAUDE.md` is documented as credential-bearing and is gitignored
impl: Keep CLAUDE.md gitignored and untracked; test asserts the ignore. Rotation and GitHub secret scanning remain Jake-todo human items.

title: SZZ runs `git diff` against an untrusted repo without isolating git config
impl: Shared isolated git helper; --no-ext-diff, blank global, cleared GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF/PAGER/DIR; applied on all caller-repo git sinks.

title: SZZ unbounded per-hunk `git blame`
impl: Cap hunks/commit and total blame calls; skip -C on wide diffs; INSUFFICIENT_DATA over budget.

title: `LanguageProfileService` joins unsanitized `language` into a file path
impl: Allowlist language `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`; resolve under profiles_dir; invalid/unknown falls back to generic.

title: Local calibration profile YAML is trusted without clamp or authenticity check
impl: Load refuses invalid YAML/numerics and re-clamps against the language/generic anchor; resolve() re-clamps to the target language.

title: `write_local_profile` write root is caller-controlled
impl: Confine project_path to cwd; refuse .. / outside roots / dest symlink.

title: (withdrawn — merged into CH-0019)
`LanguageProfile` accepts unconstrained language and numeric fields
impl: Constrain language to ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$; finite warn<=fail; reject non-positive/non-finite weights. resolve() relabels invalid language to generic.

title: Profile YAML `ValidationError` aborts `LanguageProfileService` construction
impl: _load_yaml_profile catches ValidationError/TypeError/ValueError, logs, and falls back to generic/in-code defaults.

title: Unsigned license disk cache can bypass license policy
impl: HMAC + `name@version` keys; unsigned/v1 cache ignored. `use_cache` defaults off in CI.

title: License checker performs default-on HTTP to PyPI
impl: PyPI fallback gated behind LicenseConfig.enable_network (default False).

title: Unquoted package name interpolated into the PyPI URL
impl: PEP 503 normalize + quote; reject path-like names; refuse off-host PyPI redirects.

title: `RequirementsChecker.sync` writes an unconfined `target_file`
impl: confine_sync_target rejects absolute and `..` paths; dest must be_relative_to(scan_path).

title: Unsigned vulnerability lookup cache can hide or inject CVEs
impl: HMAC + schema on vuln cache envelopes; 0o700 dir; unsigned/planted empty bodies are a miss and refetch.

title: Vuln cache key is used as a path fragment
impl: Allowlist cache keys/namespaces; hash key for filename; dest must stay under cache_dir.

title: `PackageLicense.is_allowed` defaults True (fail-open)
impl: Default `is_allowed=False`; gates use `is_policy_allowed` (`verdict == "allowed"`). Classifier still sets WARN True.

title: Unsigned dep-graph JSON cache can crash the scan
impl: HMAC + schema on dep-graph cache; hydrate errors are a miss; atomic replace; derived reused only if signed.

title: Performance directory walker follows symlinks and can recurse forever
impl: Skip file/dir symlinks; track dir inodes; require resolved paths under scan root.

title: `BugDetector` `rglob("*.py")` follows directory symlinks
impl: os.walk(followlinks=False); skip file/dir symlinks; require resolved.is_relative_to(root).

title: Language analyzers `rglob` and ignore advertised exclude/size limits
impl: Shared _confined_walk (no symlink follow); apply exclude/max_file_lines/max_findings; line cap 4096; extension allowlist.

title: Hardcoded-credential rules copy the secret into `code_snippet`
impl: JS/PHP/Ruby/Rust credential snippets and env-fallback defaults use last-2/length-only mask; CLI remasks before print/JSON.

title: `js.no-eval` remediates to `Function`
impl: js.no-eval fix_suggestion recommends JSON.parse/structured parsers only; never Function/eval.

title: PHP rule regexes are quadratic on long lines
impl: SQL-build and XSS-concat patterns bound to .{0,200}; those checks skip lines over 4096 chars.

title: Code-smell HTML report interpolates scan strings unescaped
impl: html.escape scan_path/filename/description/evidence; allowlist severity CSS classes.

title: Unsigned debt-state JSON cache can skip re-analysis
impl: HMAC on debt-state JSON; unsigned/forged load as empty (full rescan). `rel` confined with `is_relative_to`.

title: Incremental file-hash cache is unsigned and mtime-skips
impl: Always re-hash; HMAC schema v2; confine cache_path; honor TTL. `enabled` still defaults False.

title: Type checkers / linters execute untrusted project config
impl: Isolated cwd/config for pylint/flake8/mypy/pyright; no project plugins; npx --no-install; -- before paths.

title: Pyright runner writes/unlinks config in the scan tree (symlink clobber)
impl: Already closed by CH-0049 — invoke_pyright writes pyrightconfig.json in isolated_tool_workspace and passes --project there; test_linter_isolation covers it.

title: Unsigned QualityGate fingerprint baseline can hide all PR findings
impl: HMAC-SHA256 on fingerprint store (`ASGARD_QG_HMAC_KEY` or sibling `.key`); unsigned/rewritten files load as empty → NOT_EVALUATED.

title: Gate fingerprints collapse to rule+path when snippet is empty
impl: Fingerprint includes line+message; `ensure_fingerprint` recomputes unless a signed `qg1.` mac is present.

title: `ParallelScanner` pickles analyzer callables over fork IPC
impl: spawn context; worker imports named analyzer; timeout kills workers; worker_count capped at 32.

title: Unmeasured Ratings dimensions default to letter A
impl: Unmeasured dimensions are N/A and fail overall; blocker maps to E. Lazy-import Heimdall test_context in context_classifier so Ratings can load.

title: Dashboard HTML interpolates request path and issue fields unescaped
impl: html.escape all interpolated dashboard fields; allowlist badge CSS classes. 404 path and issue file_path escaped.

title: Dashboard has no authentication; `--host` can bind all interfaces
impl: Refuse 0.0.0.0/:: unless --expose. Default remains localhost. Dashboard is local-only.

title: Alignment config `file:` paths are not confined to `base_dir`
impl: confine_source_path rejects abs/`..`; dest must be_relative_to(base_dir) before read_text.

title: CodeGen interpolates untrusted OpenAPI strings into generated source
impl: JSON-encode path templates; sanitize identifiers; escape comments; jail _write_files under output_dir. `{__import__('os')}` is data, not an f-string.

title: JSON Schema `$ref` reads arbitrary local files
impl: Jail file $refs under schema dir; reject absolute/file:///http(s)/data/ftp and `..` escapes; nested loads inherit jail.

title: GraphQL introspection `urlopen` is unauthenticated SSRF
impl: http(s) only; block RFC1918/loopback/link-local unless --allow-internal; re-validate redirects; no file/ftp handlers.

title: Generated mock servers bind `0.0.0.0` with no auth and Flask `debug=True`
impl: Default bind 127.0.0.1; generated Flask debug=False; Express listens on config.host; local-only header.

title: Validation proxy is an open SSRF forwarder
impl: Localhost bind; http(s) upstream only; path jail; hop-by-hop strip; same-host redirects only.

title: LiveContract probe URL join can rewrite authority; `urlopen` follows redirects
impl: urljoin + root-relative path jail; encode path params; skip non-/ spec paths; same-host redirects only.

title: Documentation HTML interpolates title/contact/custom_css unescaped
impl: Escape title; allowlist http(s)/mailto contact hrefs; drop custom_css from HTML. javascript: URLs become #.

title: SQL `DEFAULT` interpolated unsanitized into migrations/Alembic
impl: Restrict defaults to literals; quote identifiers; Alembic op.execute(repr(sql)); reject 1;DROP / comments / newlines.

title: Freya site crawler navigates unvalidated URLs (SSRF / `file:`)
impl: http(s) only; block RFC1918/loopback unless allow_internal; re-validate page.url; SPA enqueue uses should_crawl. Other Freya page.goto (a11y/SEO/visual) still local-fixture file: paths.

title: Freya HTML/JUnit reports interpolate crawl strings unescaped
impl: Escape HTML/XML; allowlist http(s) href/src; reject javascript:/data:. Tests with script in finding message.

title: Visual baseline index can delete/copy arbitrary files
impl: confine_storage_path refuses dest symlinks and paths outside storage_directory; delete/version/load skip or raise on hostile screenshot_path.

title: Crawl reports persist `auth_config` (passwords) on disk
impl: `generate_report`/`save_report` copy config and replace secret `auth_config` values with `****`; keys kept. Deviation: length-only mask, not prefix/suffix.

title: Accessibility `page.evaluate` interpolates DOM IDs into JS
impl: `getElementById` uses a static evaluate function; `id_ref` is an argument, not source.

title: Link validator HEADs extracted links without scheme allowlist
impl: Only http(s); skip private/metadata; re-validate Location; reuse Freya URL policy.

title: Screenshot / visual-regression writes unsanitized filenames
impl: sanitize_output_name + confine_output_path; reject abs/`..`; wired into capture, regression, breakpoint tester.

title: Freya Scoring empty/unknown findings grade as A and pass
impl: Empty category scores are N/A (not A); unknown severity is BLOCKER; needs_review fails the gate; empty findings fail-closed.

title: Screenshot `hide_selectors` interpolated into `page.evaluate`
impl: hide_selectors JSON-encoded and passed as evaluate args, not JS source.

title: DNS checker runs `dig` with an unvalidated domain
impl: RFC1123-style domain allowlist; reject @ and leading -; pass dig -- domain type.

title: File-integrity baseline is unsigned; `has_changes` ignores adds
impl: HMAC-SHA256 on baseline files (`ASGARD_INTEGRITY_HMAC_KEY` or sibling `.key` 0600); unsigned/rewritten hashes fail-closed; `has_changes` includes added; O_NOFOLLOW + skip file/dir symlinks.

title: `StaticSecurityService.scan` swallows domain failures (fail-open PASS)
impl: Domain exceptions go to `SecurityReport.domain_errors` and fail `is_passing`; scanners log instead of `except: pass`.

title: Heimdall security walker follows symlinks out of the scan root
impl: iter_confined_files skips file/dir symlinks and requires resolved.is_relative_to(root); dispatch/deps/config-secrets no longer rglob/walk.

title: Secret reports leak prefix+suffix of matched values
impl: `mask_secret` defaults to last-2 or length-only; `line_content` redacted by column span. Never print both ends.

title: Unpinned (`*`) dependencies are treated as not vulnerable / live-checked
impl: Live lookup is not `checked` unless a pinned package was queried. `*` matches local CVEs and emits an unresolved finding when none exist.

title: Unsigned triage cache can plant advisory verdicts
impl: HMAC + hex-64 keys + jail under cache dir; unsigned/planted verdicts miss.

title: Opt-in Claude triage sends finding text and code to a third party
impl: Redact secret-like spans; cap code_context to 4000; system/user prompt split; untrusted model JSON; document data leaving host.

title: Config-secrets placeholder fragments drop real credentials
impl: Placeholder match is whole-value only; `"<"` dropped; flatten depth-capped and cycle-safe.

title: Injection-pattern regexes are ReDoS-prone on hostile source
impl: Bounded nested `.*` / `[^)]*` to `{0,N}`; `_scan_file` is line-bounded with 1 MiB / 4096-char caps; 50k-char non-match test. Also bounded the other greedy patterns in the same file.

title: Secret FP regex full-drops values containing `test`/`example`
impl: Placeholder FP is whole-value only; matched_text ignored; AWS/GitHub/private-key never drop on substring test/example. testhost URL and ContestWinner1 report.

title: MCP HTTP server has no authentication and runs tools on any path
impl: Bearer token required; refuse 0.0.0.0 without --expose; jail tool paths; cap body size; no traceback leak.

title: Private-index mitigation is a raw substring match
impl: detect_private_index parses uncommented pip/poetry/uv config only; commented --index-url no longer suppresses confusion findings.

title: Ratings/gate/compliance CLIs fail-open on exit status
impl: Ratings exit 1 on D/E/N/A/NOT_MEASURED; gate NOT_EVALUATED and compliance findings fail; diff-gate exceptions no longer swallowed.

title: License CLI `--denied` never reaches `LicenseConfig`
impl: `--denied` maps to `prohibited_licenses`; `--warn` to `warn_licenses`. Unset keeps dataclass defaults.

title: `heimdall scan` treats step exceptions as PASS
impl: Every step `except Exception` that records ERROR also sets `overall_exit = 1`. Raising type-check step fails the scan.

title: Evaluation corpus manifest paths are unjailed
impl: confine_eval_path rejects abs/`..`; vendored/taint/CVE holdout joins must stay under corpus/checkout root.

title: Calibration map write is unsigned and unconfined
impl: Jail save/load under CWD or HEIMDALL_CALIBRATION_DIR; HMAC when HEIMDALL_CALIBRATION_HMAC_KEY is set.

title: PR decorator `urlopen` follows redirects to a caller-controlled API base
impl: https-only API bases; quote owner/repo; same-origin redirects; refuse token to non-allowlisted hosts.

title: GitHub Actions formatter emits unsanitized workflow commands
impl: Percent-encode %, CR/LF, property :/, and :: in messages; strip remaining C0.

title: Tree-sitter parse has no size/timeout cap
impl: 2 MiB parse cap, Parser.timeout_micros 250ms, iterative ERROR walk, query cache evicts at 256.

title: `init-linter` interpolates unsanitized `project_name` into TOML/YAML/hook entry
impl: Restrict project_name to ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$.

title: Issue get/mutate is UUID-global (no project check)
impl: get/update/assign/comment require project_path and filter SQL by it; TrackedIssue stores project_path.

title: Empty SLA window set reports 100% compliance
impl: Empty compliance rate and empty SLO report are 0%; non-finite percentiles BREACHED; 0.0 targets are not skipped.

title: Sketch `from_dict` trusts unbounded attacker JSON
impl: Cap centroid/bucket count and compression; reject non-finite/negative weights; clamp DDSketch indexes. CLI merge caps files/size and jails -o.

title: Invalid anomaly baseline is treated as in-bounds
impl: Invalid baseline is not in-bounds; deviation 1.0; compare status `unknown` + significant. Empty current is unknown, not normal.

title: Service-map critical-path walk loops on cyclic parents
impl: Visited set + 4096-span cap on service-map and tracing critical-path walks. A→B→A terminates.

title: Dockerfile generator concatenates untrusted fields as instructions
impl: Reject newline/# in interpolated fields; JSON-quote HEALTHCHECK; pin Trivy digest; docker.sock only with privileged_scan.

title: Jenkins emitter interpolates `run`/`env` without hardening
impl: harden_steps; quoted sh(); refuse ''' breakout in run/env.

title: Helm chart name is interpolated into `{{ define }}` / `include`
impl: HelmChart.name allowlisted to ^[a-z0-9-]+$.

title: Generators emit floating tags, HTTP Vault, and privileged-capable services
impl: HTTPS-only vault_url; reject privileged GHA/Compose services; digest-pin known images (GitLab/CircleCI/actionlint); Helm image_tag default empty, reject latest/current.

title: Pipeline `save_to_file` joins unsanitized `config.name`
impl: safe_pipeline_name [a-z0-9-]+; confine save_to_file and scaffold writes under output_dir.

title: Volundr suppressions are unsigned YAML that delete findings
impl: YAML rejects `*`/globs and requires expiry; CI fail-closed unless HMAC verifies; `ignore_rules` cannot drop in CI.

title: Terraform module builder emits `0.0.0.0/0` egress and unsanitized HCL
impl: SG egress defaults to self=true; allowlist module/variable/output names; escape HCL string literals (`"`, `${`).

title: Incremental `FileHashCache` is unsigned and unconfined
impl: HMAC + jail cache_path; always re-hash; `store_results` defaults False. Unsigned planted result is ignored.

title: FutureItems security-scan workflow is fail-open and points at a missing directory
impl: Run scanners from Tools_Security cwd; drop continue-on-error; require SARIF output. Deviation: working-directory . (workflow already lives in Tools_Security).

title: SSL checker disables certificate verification then connects to the operator host
impl: Default verifies the peer (`CERT_REQUIRED`). `--insecure` / `verify=False` is labeled unauthenticated peek.

title: CORS/headers checkers `urlopen` operator URLs with no host allowlist
impl: Standalone URL/host allowlist; block private/metadata unless --allow-internal; cap port-scan workers at 32; re-validate redirects. CORS evil.* remain Origin headers only.

title: DNS checker passes unsanitized domain to `dig`
impl: RFC1123/IDNA hostname validation; reject leading -/ @; pass dig -- domain type.

title: SecurityAPI loads scanners with broken operator precedence and fail-opens on errors
impl: Load only module-local BaseScanner types; scan_all sets total_issues=-1 and non-zero exit on crash.

title: SecurityAPI `-o` writes the operator path with no jail
impl: Jail -o under CWD; refuse abs/`..` unless --allow-abs; only .json/.sarif.
